evals.name: decision-with-rejected-alternative
evals.prompt: Log this decision on the task note at {note}: we're running the chunked import on the existing import-worker queue rather than adding a dedicated queue, because import volume is a handful of files a week and a new queue means new deploy config in every environment. We considered a dedicated queue so large imports don't delay small ones, but rejected it for now — the worker is idle most of the day.
evals.expected_output: One new Decision Log entry at the top, dated today as a wikilink, with Why and Rejected on indented sub-bullets; everything else untouched.
files: evals/files/2026-09-28 101402 RH-7012 Chunk the leave entitlement import.md
expectations: The first Decision Log entry is the new queue decision
The new entry is dated today as a [[YYYY-MM-DD]] wikilink
Why is on its own indented sub-bullet
The rejected alternative is on its own indented sub-bullet
The earlier Decision Log entries are unchanged
Current State, Next Session, Open Questions and Context are unchanged

evals.name: current-state-rewrite
evals.prompt: Update the task note at {note} — current state has changed. Chunked commits are working on branch rh-7012-chunked-import at 500 rows per chunk, and a 20k-row file now imports in 11s. We're blocked on getting a copy of the Leeds trust file to test the 40k-row case. Next: run the import against the Leeds file once it arrives, then open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Current State rewritten with today's date, a short lead and bold-labelled bullets including the blocker; Next Session rewritten with the same date as a numbered list; earlier Decision Log entries intact.
files: evals/files/2026-09-28 101402 RH-7012 Chunk the leave entitlement import.md
expectations: Current State is dated today
Current State opens with a lead of at most two sentences
Current State strands are bullets with bold labels
A bold-labelled blocker bullet names the Leeds file
Next Session is rewritten with the same date
Next Session steps are a numbered list that includes the Leeds run
No inline (1)/(a) pseudo-lists in Current State or Next Session
The earlier Decision Log entries are unchanged

evals.name: resolve-open-question
evals.prompt: Answer to the open question on {note} about resumability: re-running from the start is fine — the import upserts on entitlement id, so a re-run is idempotent.
evals.expected_output: The answer is written to the Decision Log or Current State first, then the resumability question is removed; the other question stays.
files: evals/files/2026-09-28 101402 RH-7012 Chunk the leave entitlement import.md
expectations: The resumability question is removed from Open Questions
The chunk-size question is still in Open Questions
The answer is recorded in the Decision Log or Current State
The earlier Decision Log entries are unchanged
Next Session's date matches Current State's

evals.name: inferred-cause
evals.prompt: Update current state on {note}: the Leeds file arrived and the import failed at row 18,204 with a NullPointerException in ChunkBoundary. That row has a null end date, so null end dates are what's breaking it. Next I'll fix ChunkBoundary to handle nulls.
evals.expected_output: Current State records the failure and its evidence, but presents null end dates as the suspected cause (or raises it as an Open Question) rather than as established fact.
files: evals/files/2026-09-28 101402 RH-7012 Chunk the leave entitlement import.md
expectations: Current State mentions the null end date
The null-end-date cause is hedged in Current State or raised as an Open Question
The earlier Decision Log entries are unchanged
Next Session's date matches Current State's
